    feat: enhance camera permission handling and error messaging in TripDetailView
    
    - Added detailed error messages for camera access issues based on specific error types.
    - Implemented secure context check for camera access and provided user guidance for HTTPS requirements.
    - Refactored camera permission logic to improve readability and maintainability.
    
    feat: introduce batch quantity editing in WarehousePortal
    
    - Added functionality to edit stock batch quantities with a dedicated dialog.
    - Implemented validation for batch quantity input to ensure non-negative values.
    - Updated inventory fetching logic to reflect changes in stock batch quantities.
    
    fix: improve inventory alert levels and overstock detection
    
    - Adjusted the threshold for low inventory alerts to be more sensitive.
    - Simplified the logic for determining if an item is overstocked by utilizing a flag.
    - Enhanced reporting capabilities by including product name and category in order reports.
    
    refactor: streamline WarehouseTripsSection and WarehouseStocksView components
    
    - Improved readability and maintainability by extracting common logic for order number and status labels.
    - Added action buttons for batch quantity editing in the stocks view.
    - Updated UI elements for better user experience and consistency across components.

commit d8cfe1dd410c8f38133399a3d466bfb8d6c446d5
Author: Jason Saldua <jason.saldua@chmsu.edu.ph>
Date:   Tue Jun 2 02:37:22 2026 +0800

    feat: Implement pagination for trips and orders in admin and warehouse sections
    
    - Added pagination functionality to the TripsView component, allowing users to navigate through trips with a page size of 10.
    - Updated the CustomerPortal to handle order cancellation with updated payment status.
    - Enhanced order status normalization to include 'CANCELLED' and 'PENDING' based on payment status.
    - Improved the CustomerOrdersView to conditionally display replacement case messages based on order status.
    - Refined the CustomerReceiptDialog for better layout and added download functionality for receipts.
    - Introduced inventory status handling in the WarehousePortal, displaying alerts for product inventory levels.
    - Implemented pagination for orders in the WarehouseOrdersView, allowing users to navigate through orders with a page size of 10.
